[quote=shahban;60962483][b]Social Media Post from High Emir Rashad al-Hawrin[/b]

[i]Very recently the neighbouring Tirakani government has stated that there may be no more new Shahbani business registrations withing the Tirakani market. This has been done as a follow-up action in response to our decision to protect our enviroment and diversify our income. We have made clear that we are not stepping into an isolation, yet we are being accused of it. Our integrity is not being respected, their response is an purely unnecessary escalation of a matter that is entirely domestic, and we take this as nothing more than an insult from the Tirakani government directed at our proud country.
Our resource policy is entirely shaped by internal consensus end responsibility towards our enviroment and economy. It is not subject to external approval or judgement, nor is it an appropriate subject for economic pressure. So for clarity, no Tiraki geological survey team will be pemitted to operate within Shahbani territory. The management and use of our mineral resources and any goods are our sovereign responsibility.
And as we are being yet accused of pursuing isolation, we see that it seems to be Tirakans only intention to frame Shahban for something we are not. We are pursuing diversification, a transition awy from overdependence on any single export. The export which has been growing by over 10% annually, and is now threatening to turn Shahban into a primitive cultureless first sector mining state.

And I want to make clear that we are not friends of anyone. I note Tirakans reference to become future friends, is premature language. Mutual respect gives life to friendships, and respect begins with accepting a nations right to chart its own economic course. Therefore I give a warning to the state of Tirakan: Stop meddling with our internal affairs.

Shahban remains open to dialogue conducted in good faith and through appropriate channels. Pressure, however, will not alter our decisions.[/i]

[i]843.2k Likes | 76.3k Comments | 344.7k Shares[/i][/quote]

[b]Press Statement from Acting Premier Arlan Vos [/b]

The Government of Greater Tirakan rejects the assertion that it has insulted, framed, or misrepresented Shahban. No accusation has been made against Shahban's integrity or its right to sovereign decision-making. The claims to the contrary are inaccurate. What Tirakan has addressed, and will continue to address, are the risks arising from policy shifts combined with the breakdown of diplomatic dialogue. We've attempted to approach Shahban. They've turned us down.
In light of the public stance now taken by Shahban, and given the refusal of cooperation, Greater Tirakan will, effective immediately, classify Shahbani resource imports as "[i]strategic industrial inputs[/i]." This classification introduces more enhanced customs procedures and verification checks on Shahbani goods. They are being implemented to guarantee supply-chain integrity. This is a precautionary step, not a punitive one.

Tirakan has not accused Shahban of wrongdoing. However, Tirakan will not disregard the risk that careless political rhetoric and one-sided actions may create vulnerabilities. Responsible governance requires safeguards. Dialogue remains possible. Always. [spoiler=[b]MASTERING THE ART OF STATESMANSHIP I[/b]
[sub]"CONCERNING SUBJECT-CASE BURGUNDY & SUBJECT-CASE YALE"[/sub]][i]All official communications, treaties and accords, negotiations, and overall dialogue between the government and other related stately entities of the Combine of Eirian and her counterparts in the Interstellar Shamatist Corporate Order-State, or ISCOS, will be hereby classified as material of dossier Subject-Case Burgundy.

A short but decisive parley of transmissions would occur between the ministry diplomats and their equivalents in the ISCOS corporate-state upon the return of the original communique: an amiable attitude with a reserved wariness would be established as the current approach towards these Erenites, despite their current independence from the Erene Federation. With that said, the establishment of at least cordial-level relations with ISCOS has been classed as an objective of great importance, given that they may act as a backdoor to the Erene Federation's embargo on the food trade beyond the Belt of Tears. Upon closure of the initial introductory talks, a draft of a friendship treaty would be sent to the ISCOS.

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: THE LEADER OF THE INTERSTELLAR SHAMATIST CORPORATE ORDER-STATE AND AUTHORISED STAFF UNDER THEIR CABINET
FROM: DIPLOMATIC CORPS OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS; MINISTER DR. SEON MANCAID
CLASSIFICATION: SECURED DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 10 JANUARY 2168

SUBJECT: ESTABLISHING EIRIAN-ISCOS TREATY OF FRIENDSHIP; REQUESTING IMMEDIATE SIGNATURE OR AMENDMENT OF TERMS[/b]

To the most esteemed leader of the Interstellar Shamatist Corporate Order State, and their honorable cabinet, 

After a swift and deliberate review of our current position in the Six Republics, and with approval from the transitional Provisional Congress, the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs would love to return the hand of cooperation and good business with the ISCOS, particularly given the vital position in which the ISCOS occupies as an independent party in the Ardagan system. This transmission contains a bilateral accord, or as we would refer to it, a Treaty of Friendship, by which we put our hopes towards the proliferation of goodwill between our nations. The signing of this treaty will enact the following terms into effective order: 

[b]- The Parties confirm that, following constructive and substantive consultations, they have agreed to the formal establishment and progressive development of relations between the Combine of Eirian and the Interstellar Shamatist Corporate Order State.
- The Parties henceforth reaffirm their mutual recognition of each other as legitimate governing authorities and their commitment to relations which are wholly founded on equality, reciprocity, mutual respect, and principles of peaceful coexistence and shared prosperity; therefore, both Parties shall emphasize their shared intention to conduct relations in good faitha nd full respect of each other's political independence, legal order, and internal proccesses.
- The Parties announce the immediate establishment of formal diplomatic relations, and in this regard, have agreed to the exchange of permanent representatives under the creation of a diplomatic mission, subject to internal processes: to this end, the Combine of Eirian offers the lease of an embassy building at the Galen Embassy Plaza in the capital of Valee, and consular departments within the otehr five Republics.
- The Parties agree to maintain regular, timely, and structured political dialogue at the appropriate levels, including through periodic consultation.
- Recognizing the importance of material cooperation: the Parties therefore express an intent to promote expanded economic and trade relations based on mutual benefit. To this end, they will explore practical measures to facilitate trade, encourage long-term investment, and identify opportunities for joint economic initiatives.
- In the interest of maintaining peace and stability through Ardagan, the Parties reiterate their commitment to non-aggression and building of confidence. The signing of this Treaty will therefore enact a non-aggression pact between the Parties, which is only nullified upon the occurrence of open hostilities or other stated reasons between the Parties.
- The Parties will henceforth agree that this Treaty of Friendship shall constitute a foundational framework for continued relations between the Parties. They express a shared intent to deepen and broaden cooperation over time through understanding, protocol, or agreements, as mutually agreed  
- Any differences arising in the course of the implementation of this Treaty of Friendship shall be addressed through dialogue and consultation in a constructive and cooperative spirit.[/b]

To address the previous offer of an open trade, with a specific highlight to the trade of produce and other items, the Combine is highly interested, given the current situation of the Federation's ban on food resources beyond the Belt of Tears. The Combine of Eirian, therefore, offers its riches of rare-earth metals from Hyperborea's underseas as well as the might of its industries, by which Eirian would be able to [b]trade shipments of advanced materials, manufactured goods, medicines, and machine parts vital.[/b]Furthermore, we promise a transition, over six months upon trade beginning, from the standard tariff of [b]10% to 5%, as well as the protection of ISCOS trade ships by the Eirian Settlement Defense Fleet.[/b]     

We await your response, and hopefully your signature.

Long Live the Combine, Long Live the Six Republics, Long Live Eirian

[b]AURIN BRENN[/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs[/sub][/list]

([nation]-ISCOS-[/nation])  

---

All official communications, treaties and accords, negotiations, and overall dialogue between the government and other related stately entities of the Combine of Eirian and her counterparts in the Confederation of Feyria, or Feyria, will be hereby classified as material of dossier Subject-Case Yale.

With Feyria's position as a backyard neighbor, given their stewardship of the Hyperborean moon of Agartha, as well as their existence as Spacenoid rather than Erenites, the discourse with the Feyrians would take a more courtly approach, with Eirian diplomats willing to make concessions to the Feyrians to establish strong, foundational relations. Furthermore, Feyria's history as a former colony now independent is one that Eirian strongly identifies with...  

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: PRESIDENT THORMOD TODENSKOLD AND AUTHORISED STAFF OF HIS CABINET
FROM: DIPLOMATIC CORPS OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS; MINISTER DR. SEON MANCAID
CLASSIFICATION: SECURED DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 10 JANUARY 2168

SUBJECT: ESTABLISHING EIRIAN-FEYRIAN TREATY OF FRIENDSHIP; REQUESTING IMMEDIATE SIGNATURE OR AMENDMENT OF TERMS[/b]

To His Utmost Excellency, the most esteemed President of the Confederacy of Feyria, and his honored cabinet,

Before the introduction of the subject matter, the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs, on behalf of the Six Republics and its peoples, would love to extend a genuine, heartfelt message of congratulations to the Confederacy for its bold choice to pursue independence from the Federation. As Eirian takes its first steps of fledgling sovereignty, we express our best wishes to you and your people for this achievement: as we in the Six Republics say, the Symphony of Freedom knows no bounds or barrier. Nevertheless, the Combine of Eirian seeks to sign a Treaty of Friendship with the Confederacy of Feyria, based on the following terms.  

[b]- The Parties confirm that, following constructive and substantive consultations, they have agreed to the formal establishment and progressive development of relations between the Combine of Eirian and the Confederacy of Feyria.
- The Parties henceforth reaffirm their mutual recognition of each other as legitimate governing authorities and their commitment to relations which are wholly founded on equality, reciprocity, mutual respect, and principles of peaceful coexistence and shared prosperity; therefore, both Parties shall emphasize their shared intention to conduct relations in good faith and full respect of each other's political independence, legal order, and internal proccesses.
- The Parties announce the immediate establishment of formal diplomatic relations, and in this regard, have agreed to the exchange of permanent representatives under the creation of a diplomatic mission, subject to internal processes: to this end, the Combine of Eirian offers the lease of an embassy building at the Galen Embassy Plaza in the capital of Valee, and consular departments within the otehr five Republics.
- The Parties agree to maintain regular, timely, and structured political dialogue at the appropriate levels, including through periodic consultation.
- Recognizing the importance of material cooperation: the Parties therefore express an intent to promote expanded economic and trade relations based on mutual benefit. To this end, they will explore practical measures to facilitate trade, encourage long-term investment, and identify opportunities for joint economic initiatives.
- In the interest of maintaining peace and stability through Ardagan, the Parties reiterate their commitment to non-aggression and building of confidence. The signing of this Treaty will therefore enact a non-aggression pact between the Parties, which is only nullified upon the occurrence of open hostilities or other stated reasons between the Parties.
- The Parties will henceforth agree that this Treaty of Friendship shall constitute a foundational framework for continued relations between the Parties. They express a shared intent to deepen and broaden cooperation over time through understanding, protocol, or agreements, as mutually agreed  
- Any differences arising in the course of the implementation of this Treaty of Friendship shall be addressed through dialogue and consultation in a constructive and cooperative spirit.[/b]  

Taking into consideration the proximity of our two nations, we personally believe [b]that expanding this treaty, of course, at the behest of your government, towards further cooperation socially, economically, and militarily would bring in great prosperity.[/b] Furthermore, taking into account your offer of a mutual trade agreement, [b]we will agree to the purchase of both tonnages of ice and water from Eirian, in exchange for some return in metals or manufactured goods. Per standard tariffs, Feyrian goods will be taxed at a 10%, which may be applied for a cut to a lower level of 8% and lastly to 5% if not lowered automatically through goodwill. [/b]

We await your response, and your honored signature,   

[b]AURIN BRENN[/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs[/sub][/list]

([nation]Feyria[/nation])
